title: 30A Sunrise | Scenic 30A Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Enjoy 30A Sunrise, an 8-bedroom home in Seagrove with a private pool, Gulf views, and close beach access. Ideal for family gatherings.
description_expanded: 30A Sunrise Features - 100 Yards from the San Juan Beach Access - Gulf Views! - Homes on the corner of San Juan and 30A. There is no need to back out onto 30A as the driveway is off San Juan. - Private dip pool, spa and sundeck. Pool and spa can be heated for an additional fee for reservations October - April - Outdoor Grill - Access to 6 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly to keep them in top shape - 6 Min bike ride to Seaside with lots of shopping and dining options - 1 Min bike ride to Prema Organic Cafe and Balance Health Studio with pop-in yoga classes. - Access to a 6-seater LSV (Golf Cart). Some restrictions apply and must sign waiver to use cart during your stay - Designer EVERYTHING! Incredible details throughout the home perfectly combining high-end luxury with coastal beach comfort - Pet friendly for up to 2 dogs, 45 pounds or less, non-shedding. Must get approval from Exclusive 30A and pay a non-refundable pet fee pet pet to avoid fines - Separate Carriage House with sleeping for 4 in two bedrooms, full bath, living room, and kitchenette. Carriage house private entrance accessed by stairs facing the pool area - Private elevator in the main house, which travels to all floors. Adult use only. Please ask for details regarding mobility considerations for anyone in your group. - 1st floor game room with ping pong table and lounge area - Laundry rooms on the 1st and 3rd floor of the main house - Living rooms on the 1st, 2nd, and 4th floor - Full Gourmet Kitchen and main dining on the 2nd Floor - Kitchenette and lounge area on the 4th floor with Smart TV - 2nd Floor furnished balcony overlooking pool area - 4th Floor furnished balcony with panoramic Gulf Views - 4 backpack beach chairs , 2 umbrella setups and 2 beach wagons available - SmartTVs with streaming services (no cable) throughout the home - Garage parking for 2 vehicles and driveway parking for 3 vehicles. RVs, Trailers, and street parking not permitted. - Concierge services available including grocery delivery, private chef services, beach service, baby equipment rentals, boat charters, and more! - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Welcome to your slice of paradise! Nestled just 100 yards from the pristine sands of the beach, this luxurious home offers the ultimate coastal retreat. As you step inside, you'll be greeted by an exquisite interior adorned with elegant furnishings and coastal-inspired decor. Entertaining is a breeze in the gourmet kitchen, complete with top-of-the-line appliances, granite countertops, and a large island with seating. Whip up culinary delights while enjoying the company of friends and family in the adjacent dining area or take the party outdoors to the covered patio with a built-in grill and al fresco dining area. But the luxury doesn't end there - this home also features a private pool, where you can take a refreshing dip or soak up the sun on plush lounge chairs. For the adventurous at heart, hop on one of the provided bikes or take the golf cart for a spin around the neighborhood, exploring all that Seagrove has to offer. For guests seeking additional privacy, the carriage house apartment offers a serene retreat with its own living area, kitchenette, two bedrooms, and a full bath. Need something larger? An identical home is available right next door! Perfect for wedding parties, reunions, or corporate retreats to enjoy the best 30A has to offer. Ask for more details! ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
rooms_guidance: 1st Floor Bunk Room | sleeps up to 4 in Two Twin XL/Twin XL Bunks, adjacent to full bath with combo shower/tub
2nd Floor King Suite 1 | partial Gulf view, reach-in closet, TV, ensuite bath with walk-in shower
3rd Floor King Suite 2 | private balcony with Gulf view, TV, walk-in closet, ensuite bath with walk-in shower
3rd Floor King Suite 3 | TV, walk-in closet, ensuite bath with walk-in shower
3rd Floor Queen Suite | sleeps up to 4 in Two Queen Beds, TV, walk-in closet, ensuite bath with walk-in shower
4th Floor King Suite 4 | TV, walk-in closet, ensuite bath with walk-in shower and soaking tub
Carriage House Queen Guest Room | main floor of carriage house (must use stairs for entry to carriage house), adjacent to full bath with walk-in shower
Carriage House King Loft | sitting room, walk-in closet, access to full bath on the main floor of carriage house

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
